_comment: Port life (scripts/port_life.gd). Each happening: when (event conditions; town.* keys read the port's situation: wealth, prosperity, hunger, order, piety 0-100, war, lawless, fleet), chance per day once possible, days it lasts, cooldown days before it can come again, effects while it lasts (hire_cost and sailors multiply, rumours adds), an optional market shock (economy.json shocks) when it starts, news that spreads at the speed of a ship, names by nation, captain: true to bring a named captain to the tavern, and an action a visiting captain can take (events: one is picked, the one seen least lately; requires: conditions on you). lasts_while: it ends as soon as its 'when' stops holding (a riot once the town is fed or calmed), with ends_news.

festival.name: Feast day
festival.text: {name} in {port}: music in the streets, cheap wine, every tavern open all night, and a crowd for any show of skill.

fair.name: The fleet's fair
fair.text: The fleet is in, and {port} has turned into one great market: merchants from Seville, muleteers from the interior, sharpers and moneylenders from everywhere.

press_gang.name: Press gangs
press_gang.text: The navy is short of men for the war, and the press gangs are out in {port}. Seamen keep off the streets, and the few who'll sign on want more.
press_gang.news: The press gangs are out in {port}.

bread_riot.name: Bread riots
bread_riot.text: Food is dear in {port} and the poor can't afford to eat. Crowds outside the bakers, stones through the merchants' windows, militia on the corners. Desperate men will sign on for almost nothing.

action.text: Go down to the market square

bread_riot.ends_news: The bread riots in {port} have died down.

governors_ball.name: The governor's ball
governors_ball.text: The governor of {port} gives a ball: planters' wives in silk, officers in their best coats, merchants doing business behind the potted palms. Everyone who matters is there, and everyone is watching everyone else.
governors_ball.news: The governor of {port} is giving a ball.

action.refused: No invitation: you need standing 5 with this nation, an honest name (honour 0 or better), and no price on your head.

hanging.name: Hanging day
hanging.text: Pirates are to hang at {port}'s gallows. A crowd gathers early; the hawkers sell ballads of their crimes. The governor wants every sailor in the harbour to see it.

fever.name: Yellow jack
fever.text: Fever in {port}. The church bells toll every day; ships anchor in the outer roads and send their boats in as little as they can.
fever.news: Yellow fever has broken out in {port}.

captains_drinking.name: A captain in the tavern
captains_drinking.text: {captain}, captain of the {ship}, is ashore in {port}, drinking with the crew in the best tavern on the waterfront.

revolt.name: A rising on the plantations
revolt.text: The enslaved on the plantations around {port} have risen. Cane fields burn on the hills at night; the militia has marched inland and the planters' families crowd the fort. Whoever escapes heads for the coast, and the sea.
revolt.ends_news: The rising around {port} is over; the militia is back in town.
revolt.news: The plantations around {port} have risen in revolt.

procession.name: A procession
procession.text: The church of {port} carries its saint through the streets: candles, incense, the confraternities in their hoods, and the whole town on its knees as it passes.

smugglers.name: The smugglers' night market
smugglers.text: The customs men in {port} look the other way after dark, and the beach below the town fills with boats: foreign cloth, tools and wine for the townsfolk, no questions asked.

action.text: Go down to the beach after dark
action.refused: With a price on your head, the smugglers won't risk dealing with you.

muster.name: Privateers mustering
muster.text: The governor of {port} is fitting out privateers against the enemy: commissions for the asking, a bounty for every prize, and every tavern full of captains looking for hands.
